COMPLETE VISIBLE RESPONSE (math reproduced from visible TeX annotations; citations retain visible URLs):

I have not resolved the full universal-computation question. I do not have a compiler implementing every circuit $C$ under your constant-fraction adversary, and I do not have a general impossibility theorem for that compiler.

The additional construction I can justify is stronger than the previously accepted storage result: one uniformly constructible code family now supports noisy-syndrome recovery, preparation of complete logical zero/plus blocks, internally prepared encoded Bell states, and repeatable whole-block teleportation with recovery, under a constant global adversarial fault fraction. The classical algorithms are executable and polynomial in bit work. The code representation can also be generated uniformly, with computable fixed preprocessing costs.

This removes the supplied-representation and protected-Bell-preparation gaps for these operations. It does not supply protected logical universality. In particular, I have not constructed an addressable non-Clifford operation or a compatible universal sequence of code changes.

Below I give the construction, its resource contract, and the exact remaining boundary.

1. Scope of the additional result

Use the accepted good-qLTC construction in six directions, with the quantum code in degree three. Its fixed local parameters can be chosen to provide the additional adjacent-degree expansion needed below. This is a different family from the quantum Tanner family and from the injection/ejection family; their operations are not silently identified. The underlying code, distance, local expansion, and arithmetic existence results are credited to the good-qLTC paper. arxiv.org [https://arxiv.org/html/2609.20780v1?utm_source=chatgpt.com]

The resulting construction has fixed computable constants

$$R_0,\Delta,\rho_{\mathrm{stab}}>0$$

and a uniform family of binary CSS codes $Q_n$ with at least $R_0n$ logical qubits, distance at least $\Delta n$, and bounded check weight and incidence.

For an arbitrary number $R$ of recovery/transfer cycles, it gives:

- A fixed physical alphabet $d=2$.

- Quantum gadgets using the Clifford subset of the finite universal set
$$\{H,T,\mathrm{CNOT},X,Z,\text{prepare }|0\rangle,\text{measure }Z\}.$$


- Total allocated quantum workspace $N\le A n$, for a fixed computable $A$.

The complete argument and explicit arithmetic seed are in my preceding report. The key audited points are:

- Exact orbit testing is a finite lattice calculation because local vertex conditions bound denominators and total definiteness bounds every archimedean coordinate.

- Finite-quotient BFS terminates and generates the full congruence lattice through its edge transporters.

- Finite local-ball tests find a valid initial level.

- All larger cosheaves are pullbacks of the computed base cosheaf.

- Congruence image sizes have bounded adjacent ratio and exponential lower growth in the level, giving $O(\log N)$-bit ring precision.

- Deterministic list-based enumeration suffices for a conservative $C_0+O(N^2\operatorname{polylog}N)$ construction bound.

The same-family preparation, recovery, Bell-preparation and teleportation operations can therefore be called uniform once combined with your established $t=6$ decoder and metasyndrome proofs. Their enormous constants are computable, but were not numerically evaluated or shown practical.

The full constant-fraction adversarial universal fault-tolerance compiler remains unresolved. I did not supply the compatible protected logical universality operation needed to turn these uniform stabilizer operations into that compiler, nor a general obstruction to doing so.
